plan.text: Win the diamond lead in South, then cash the club ace and king and lead a third club toward dummy’s queen. A 3–2 split provides five club tricks; against 4–1, concede one club to establish a fourth winner. Use the heart and spade entries to reach the established clubs, retaining the second diamond stopper until needed. Reassess if clubs split 5–0 or the defense changes the timing.
